## Overview

- Improve fixed-viewport rendering parity across Canvas, presenter view, and Desktop.
- Correct slide layout, navigation, editing, accessibility, performance, and export behavior for the updated renderer.
- Keep the Canvas Extension, Agent Skills, CLI, and Desktop on the unified 3.8.1 release.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Markdown decks. No migration is required.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.8.1`. |
